newsitem.title: INDIA: India gets $250 mln World Bank malaria project aid.
newsitem.headline: India gets $250 mln World Bank malaria project aid.

text.p: The World Bank has agreed to provide an 8.91 billion rupee ($250 million) loan to India for a malaria control project, Health Minister Renuka Chowdhury said on Thursday.
The project, covering 100 districts in seven states, will facilitate the use of new environment-friendly chemicals to control malaria, which is transmitted by mosquitoes.
The five-year concessional credit will cover 85 percent of the project cost, Chowdhury said. She gave no other details.
Some two million Indians suffer from malaria annually, compared to nearly 6.5 million in 1976. ($1=35.7 rupees)
